label: ProductForge-Dashboard Backlog 53
title: UI: seat + quota usage and limits
body:
## Original (as captured)
Show seats used/available and project create/run concurrency + totals vs the tier limit; block/queue beyond.

## Context (from linked item product_forge:BI-0063)
Enforce seat limits and per-tier (and per-user/tenant) project create/run concurrency + totals by extending core/capacity.py with a license/tier context (global limits remain the hard ceiling).
